subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should context-engine control be a dispatchable Gateway RPC surface, an HTTP-only operator endpoint, or a plugin-owned/ClawHub integration outside core?
rationale: The correct repair changes public API shape, client discovery, plugin SDK contract, and security boundary; automation cannot choose that product contract safely.

options.title: Confirm core API and fix before merge
options.body: A maintainer chooses HTTP-only or dispatchable RPC, then the branch aligns descriptors, handlers, docs, SDK exports, and regression tests before merge.

options.title: Accept experimental core surface
options.body: Maintain the new core route with explicit ownership of the plugin SDK and security-boundary follow-up risk.

options.title: Defer outside core
options.body: Pause or close this PR if context-engine maintenance control should live in a plugin or ClawHub package instead of the core Gateway.

recommendation.title: Confirm core API and fix before merge
recommendation.body: A maintainer chooses HTTP-only or dispatchable RPC, then the branch aligns descriptors, handlers, docs, SDK exports, and regression tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway API and operator-scope work makes steipete the strongest current routing owner for this product/API decision.
